nodes.label: CORE-02 Design system
nodes.rationale: Pick one teal: token is #00BBB0 but #17C3B2 is hardcoded in 19 files.

nodes.label: CORE-05 HTTP client & error model
nodes.rationale: Resolve relative photo URLs against the real backend origin, not localhost:8090.

nodes.label: CORE-07 Native risk spikes
nodes.rationale: Done early in parallel with M1: video, push, audio and WebView are most likely to force architecture changes.

nodes.label: ONB-01 Onboarding carousel (optional)
nodes.rationale: No onboarding exists in Flutter; only a new feature if product wants it.

nodes.label: LOCK-01 App-lock core service
nodes.rationale: Store a salted hash, not the PIN, and compare in constant time.

nodes.label: AUTH-04 Register OTP verify + PIN setup
AUTH-05 Existing doctor to patient account
AUTH-08 Logout & session expiry
nodes.rationale: Clear copilot memory and profile state on logout, and await logout before navigating.

nodes.label: HOME-04 Shared-state check
nodes.rationale: In Flutter Home and Doctors/Bookings share one provider and last loader wins; Home must own its state.

nodes.label: DOC-01 Doctors list: search, filters, pagination
DOCS-03 Document details, viewer, delete
nodes.rationale: Send the Bearer token only to the backend origin and do not log out on a 401 from a file host.

nodes.label: CHAT-01 Conversation list + start a chat
NOTIF-04 Tap routing (push, local, inbox)
nodes.rationale: A chat notification should open the conversation; Flutter ignores chatId.

nodes.label: AI-01 Gating, entry button, streaming chat
nodes.rationale: One gating rule (PATIENT_SHIFA_AI feature, falling back to tier) for bar, router and screen; use the shared Ktor client.

nodes.label: PROF-01 Profile screen + language dialog
nodes.rationale: Flutter Privacy item is a no-op; link a real privacy policy or hide it.

nodes.label: PROF-04 Location picker + geocoding
nodes.rationale: Ship a real Maps/geocoding key or a fallback geocoder; Flutter store builds silently lose picked locations.

nodes.label: LOCK-03 Lock screen, lifecycle triggers, biometrics
nodes.rationale: Verify on submit or at stored PIN length; Flutter checks at 4 digits so 5-6 digit PINs never unlock.

nodes.label: PROF-06 Delete account (email OTP)
nodes.rationale: Phone-only accounts cannot delete in Flutter because email is required; ask backend for a phone path.

nodes.label: REL-02 Crash reporting
nodes.rationale: Crashlytics was a Flutter dependency but never initialized.
